findings.issue: /pokemon/:name and /team render cookie-dependent HTML with no Vary: Cookie or Cache-Control, so a shared reverse-proxy or heuristic browser cache can serve one user's team state to another or a stale Add/Remove button
findings.suggestion: Set `Vary: Cookie` (or `Cache-Control: no-store`) on the /team and /pokemon/:name routes, mirroring the Vary already set for HX-Request on '/'

findings.issue: Team mutations read-modify-write the cookie with no serialization; concurrent POSTs (e.g. two fast clicks on Remove buttons, team.tsx:133, which has no hx-sync) race and can drop updates
findings.suggestion: Add hx-sync to the team buttons (as done on the home form) or make the POST handlers idempotent under last-write-wins by re-reading the cookie server-side per request in a single critical section

findings.issue: The entire PokeAPI surface is typed as `any` (api<T = any>, casts like pokemon.tsx:191 `g: any`), so renames and shape changes in API data fail silently at runtime instead of at tsc
findings.suggestion: Define interfaces for the resources actually consumed (species, pokemon, type, move, ability, generation) in api.ts or data.ts and use api<T> everywhere

findings.issue: POST /team/add/:name writes arbitrary unvalidated names into the cookie; loadTeam later drops unknown species silently, so the stored team can diverge from the displayed one
findings.suggestion: Validate the name against the species list (the data is cached anyway) and reject or ignore unknown names when writing the cookie

findings.issue: notFound() and onError() return full page documents even when the request is an htmx partial, so swapping a fragment (e.g. a moves-table or results div) would inject a whole HTML page
findings.suggestion: Branch on isPartial(c) in notFound/onError and return a bare fragment for HX-Request requests

findings.issue: Stale-while-revalidate background refresh failures are swallowed with .catch(() => {}), so a persistently failing API serves stale data forever with no signal
findings.suggestion: Log refresh failures (or set a short error backoff on the entry) instead of discarding the rejection

findings.issue: The in-memory cache Map is never evicted; memory is bounded only by the assumption that the API is a fixed snapshot, which is undocumented
findings.suggestion: Document the bounded-snapshot assumption next to the cache, or add TTL/LRU eviction keyed on FRESH_MS

findings.issue: typesByPokemonId (and speciesById via cardsForPokemon, data.ts:91) rebuild ~1000-entry Maps on every request from cached records — repeated O(dataset) work per page view
findings.suggestion: Memoize the derived maps alongside the API cache (e.g. rebuild only when the upstream entries refresh)

findings.issue: addToTeam/removeFromTeam are declared async but contain no awaits, which misleads readers into assuming I/O
findings.suggestion: Drop the async keyword (or hoist species validation inside so it does await)

findings.issue: The home full page is rendered with { title: '' } to hit the layout's fallback branch — a slightly awkward encoding of 'no title suffix'
findings.suggestion: Make the renderer props title optional ({ title?: string }) instead of passing an empty string

summary: A genuinely idiomatic Hono 4 + htmx app on current stable versions, with clean layering (api client → domain mapping → per-page loaders/views) that a team could own comfortably. The merge blockers are small and concentrated in the team feature: an unsynchronized cookie read-modify-write race, missing Vary: Cookie on cookie-dependent pages, and an untyped API surface. Fix those in one small round and it's an easy approve.
